detail.longDescription: I spent part of today rebuilding another upstream container image locally, with a security patch applied that’s available but not yet built into the upstream image. We’re now at a point where when you run services, you need to build the whole hierarchy of used images yourself and ‘FROM scratch’, fully automated in CI. You need to be able to rebuild any of them with customizations/updates applied at short notice and all images derived FROM that image updated promptly as well. No more FROM some/random/image:tag. Not every project I’m on is there yet, but the need for change is evident and discussed everywhere. # docker # podman # containers # linux # hosting # itsecurity # security
